# Core Summary
This 15-second vertical cinematic trailer embodies an epic Wuxia aesthetic, blending low-saturation ink wash tones with dramatic volumetric lighting across a four-shot narrative progression. The sequence opens with a silhouetted revelation at a bamboo door, escalates through an emotional close-up and a cryptic letter reveal, and concludes with a majestic aerial landscape fading into the title. The structure follows a strict 4s-4s-3s-4s rhythm, utilizing [cut] transitions to maintain high tension and visual density appropriate for short-form vertical storytelling.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Interior looking out through a heavy, textured bamboo door frame. The exterior is overwhelmed by blinding golden sunlight, creating a high-contrast backlight situation. Dust motes dance in the light beams. The bamboo wood is dark, weathered, and grainy.
*Audio Description*: Epic orchestral score begins low and slow. Deep, resonant bass drone. Sound of heavy wood groaning.

[shot2][00:04-00:08] Softly lit interior space, shallow depth of field. Background is blurred dark wood and shadow to isolate the subject's face. Lighting is directional, casting subtle shadows to emphasize facial structure and expression changes.
*Audio Description*: Music intensity increases slightly. String section enters. Ambient wind howl outside.

[shot3][00:08-00:11] Extreme macro view of aged, yellowed paper texture. Fibers of the paper are visible. Ink strokes are thick and textured. Lighting is focused on the text, with shadows shifting as the paper moves.
*Audio Description*: Sharp wind gust sound. Drum beat kicks in rhythmically.

[shot4][00:11-00:15] Exterior aerial landscape. Misty mountain peaks covered in green bamboo forests. Clouds swirl rapidly (time-lapse feel). The scene transitions to a solid dark background for text.
*Audio Description*: Music swells to climax then abruptly cuts to silence/reverb tail. Title card sound effect.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A> (Yun Che)
*Gender*: Male
*Race/Ethnicity*: East Asian
*Age*: Young adult (late teens)
*Appearance features*: Wearing traditional black Hanfu robes with wide sleeves. Hair is tied back in a traditional topknot with loose strands framing the face. Sharp jawline, clear skin.
*Vocal Characteristics*: N/A (No dialogue).

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Low angle shot looking up at <ID_A> from inside a dark room. <ID_A> stands centered, facing away from the camera, pushing open two heavy bamboo doors. As the doors open, a massive flood of golden sunlight bursts from behind <ID_A>, instantly turning his body into a pure black silhouette. His black robes and hair strands flutter violently in the wind generated by the opening door. The light intensity increases rapidly, washing out details except for the outline. Sound of heavy wood creaking mixes with a sudden wind rush.

[shot2][00:04-00:08] [cut-in] Medium close-up on <ID_A>'s face, now lit by soft, diffused light. <ID_A> holds a paper letter in hands (out of frame), looking down. <ID_A>'s expression shifts visibly: eyebrows start relaxed, then furrow deeply within two seconds. Eyes widen slightly, then the lower eyelids tense and turn red. Head tilts down further as shock registers. Camera slowly pushes in (dolly in) to heighten tension. Sound of a heartbeat thumps quietly under the rising orchestral strings.

[shot3][00:08-00:11] [cutaway] Extreme close-up on the yellowed letter held in <ID_A>'s hands. The paper flutters in the wind. Black ink calligraphy is sharp and focused. The text `"亡秦必楚"` is clearly visible in the center. Shadows sweep across the paper as it ripples. Camera remains static but the paper moves dynamically. A heavy Chinese war drum hits on the beat with the wind gust.

[shot4][00:11-00:15] [cut to] High-angle aerial drone shot soaring over misty mountain peaks covered in bamboo. The clouds move rapidly. The image quickly fades to black from the edges inward. As the screen darkens, the dynamic title `"沧海成尘"` emerges in silver-white calligraphy in the center, glowing faintly. Music reaches a crescendo then cuts to a lingering reverb.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style mimics high-budget historical epic trailers with an ink wash painting influence. Color palette is low saturation, dominated by muted greens, charcoal greys, and deep blacks, contrasted sharply by the blinding gold of the light in Shot 1. Lighting is cinematic and volumetric, using heavy backlighting and rim light to separate subjects from the background. Texture is grainy and filmic, avoiding digital crispness in favor of atmospheric depth. Vertical composition (9:16) emphasizes height and scale.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
The atmosphere is solemn, mysterious, and epic. It conveys a sense of destiny and heavy burden. The emotional arc moves from revelation (light) to personal shock (face) to historical weight (text) to grand scale (landscape). The viewer should feel the gravity of a turning point in a larger historical narrative.
